---
name: Code Review Baseline
description: Baseline diff review for regressions, contract drift, and missing tests with evidence-backed findings only.
---

Canonical definition: `.github/skills/code-review-baseline/SKILL.md`

Use for:
- lightweight pre-merge review where speed matters
- confirming a small diff doesn't introduce regressions
- situations where the standard code-review skill is overkill

Prefer `code-review` for full-scope review work. Use `code-review-aggressive` for high-risk or safety-critical changes.
